{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "Dilute 24 serum samples 1 in 10 and transfer duplicates",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_racks = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_1000ul", 1)
    tubes = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 2)
    pbs_reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 3)
    dil_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_2ml_deep", 4)
    elisa_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 5)
    p1000 = protocol.load_instrument("p1000_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_racks])

    # Define liquids
    for i in range(1, 25):
        serum_name = f"serum {i}"
        protocol.define_liquid(
            name=serum_name,
            description=f"Serum sample {i}",
            display_color="#FF0000"
        )
        # Determine well name in tube rack
        if i <= 6:
            well_name = f"A{i}"
        elif i <= 12:
            well_name = f"B{i-6}"
        elif i <= 18:
            well_name = f"C{i-12}"
        else:
            well_name = f"D{i-18}"
        # Load 1500 µL of serum into the well
        tubes[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=serum_name, volume=1500)

    # Define PBS
    protocol.define_liquid(
        name="pbs",
        description="Phosphate Buffered Saline",
        display_color="#0000FF"
    )
    # Load 12000 µL of PBS into reservoir well A1
    pbs_reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid="pbs", volume=12000)

    # Generate source well names in order (A1-A6, B1-B6, C1-C6, D1-D6)
    source_well_names = []
    for row in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]:
        for col in range(1, 7):
            source_well_names.append(row + str(col))

    # Get destination wells in dilution plate (first 24 wells)
    dil_dest_wells = list(dil_plate.wells())[:24]

    # Fill dilution plate
    for i in range(24):
        p1000.pick_up_tip()
        # Aspirate 50 µL from serum
        p1000.aspirate(50, tubes[source_well_names[i]])
        # Aspirate 450 µL from PBS reservoir
        p1000.aspirate(450, pbs_reservoir["A1"])
        # Dispense 500 µL into dilution well
        p1000.dispense(500, dil_dest_wells[i])
        p1000.drop_tip()

    # Get list of destination wells in ELISA plate (first 48 wells)
    elisa_dest_wells = list(elisa_plate.wells())[:48]

    # Transfer 100 µL from each dilution well to duplicate wells in ELISA plate
    for i in range(24):
        p1000.pick_up_tip()
        # Aspirate 100 µL from dilution well
        p1000.aspirate(100, dil_dest_wells[i])
        # Dispense 100 µL to first duplicate well
        p1000.dispense(100, elisa_dest_wells[2*i])
        # Dispense 100 µL to second duplicate well
        p1000.dispense(100, elisa_dest_wells[2*i+1])
        p1000.drop_tip()"}

protocol.py: 2 biology problems (2 errors).

1. ERROR PIPETTE-RANGE: 50 ul is below what the p1000_single_gen2 can measure (100 ul at

   (this line did it 24 times). A pipette cannot measure less than its minimum: it draws the

   simulator passes the move. Wells: tubes A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B2 and 16 more in
   slot 2.

   Fix: Use a pipette whose range covers the volume (a p20 for 1 to 20 ul), or scale the
   reaction so every volume is at least the pipette's minimum.
   Source: Opentrons: pipette characteristics (volume ranges)
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/pipettes/characteristics.html
   Source: Integra: pipetting tips (work at 35 to 100% of nominal volume)
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/united-states/en/pipetting-tips
   [51709885806b]

2. ERROR CONTAM-STOCK: A used tip went into a stock: pbs (well A1 in slot 3)
   line 62:  p1000.aspirate(450, pbs_reservoir["A1"])
   At line 62 the tip went into pbs (well A1 in slot 3) while it still carried serum 1 (tube
   A1 in slot 2), serum 2 (tube A2 in slot 2), serum 3 (tube A3 in slot 2), serum 4 (tube A4
   in slot 2) and 20 more from an earlier step (this line did it 24 times). A tip that has
   touched one liquid leaves a little of it in the next liquid it touches, so this stock now

tool_calls.arguments:
{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "Dilute 24 serum samples 1 in 10 and transfer duplicates",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_racks_300 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    tip_racks_1000 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_1000ul", 2)
    tubes = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_1.5ml_snapcap", 3)
    pbs_reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 4)
    dil_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_2ml_deep", 5)
    elisa_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 6)
    # Load pipettes
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tip_racks_300])
    p1000 = protocol.load_instrument("p1000_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_racks_1000])

    # Define liquids
    for i in range(1, 25):
        serum_name = f"serum {i}"
        # Define liquid and get the liquid object
        serum_liquid = protocol.define_liquid(
            name=serum_name,
            description=f"Serum sample {i}",
            display_color="#FF0000"
        )
        # Determine well name in tube rack
        if i <= 6:
            well_name = f"A{i}"
        elif i <= 12:
            well_name = f"B{i-6}"
        elif i <= 18:
            well_name = f"C{i-12}"
        else:
            well_name = f"D{i-18}"
        # Load 1500 µL of serum into the well
        tubes[well_name].load_liquid(liquid=serum_liquid, volume=1500)

    # Define PBS
    pbs_liquid = protocol.define_liquid(
        name="pbs",
        description="Phosphate Buffered Saline",
        display_color="#0000FF"
    )
    # Load 12000 µL of PBS into reservoir well A1
    pbs_reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=pbs_liquid, volume=12000)

    # Generate source well names in order (A1-A6, B1-B6, C1-C6, D1-D6)
    source_well_names = []
    for row in ["A", "B", "C", "D"]:
        for col in range(1, 7):
            source_well_names.append(row + str(col))

    # Get destination wells in dilution plate (first 24 wells)
    dil_dest_wells = list(dil_plate.wells())[:24]

    # Fill dilution plate
    for i in range(24):
        # Aspirate 50 µL serum with p300
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        p300.aspirate(50, tubes[source_well_names[i]])
        p300.dispense(50, dil_dest_wells[i])
        p300.drop_tip()
        # Aspirate 450 µL PBS with p1000
        p1000.pick_up_tip()
        p1000.aspirate(450, pbs_reservoir["A1"])
        p1000.dispense(450, dil_dest_wells[i])
        p1000.drop_tip()

    # Get list of destination wells in ELISA plate (first 48 wells)
    elisa_dest_wells = list(elisa_plate.wells())[:48]

    # Transfer 100 µL from each dilution well to duplicate wells in ELISA plate
    for i in range(24):
        p1000.pick_up_tip()
        # Aspirate 200 µL from dilution well
        p1000.aspirate(200, dil_dest_wells[i])
        # Dispense 100 µL to first duplicate well
        p1000.dispense(100, elisa_dest_wells[2*i])
        # Dispense 100 µL to second duplicate well
        p1000.dispense(100, elisa_dest_wells[2*i+1])
        p1000.drop_tip()"}

The issue is that we are dispensing into wells that already have liquid (the dilution plate wells) before mixing. The plate map expects that each well of the dilution plate should hold exactly 500 µL of diluted serum (i.e., 50 µL serum + 450 µL PBS). However, we are dispensing 50 µL serum into each well, then later dispensing 450 µL PBS into the same well, but we are doing it sequentially with separate tips, which means that the well may have residual liquid from previous steps? Actually the issue is that we are adding serum to the well, then later adding PBS to the same well, but we are not mixing them; the well may have a layer of serum at the bottom and then we add PBS on top, leading to incomplete mixing.
